tasks.title: Document Firebase Collections and Database Architecture
tasks.description: Analyze and document all existing Firebase collections, their schemas, relationships, and data flow patterns.
tasks.details:
1. Access Firebase console and retrieve collection information
2. Document schemas for all collections (bible, ck_continuity, ck_guidance_index, priming, handoffs, summaries)
3. Create an Entity-Relationship Diagram (ERD) to visualize collection relationships
4. Document data flow patterns between collections
5. Analyze and document security rules and access control patterns
6. Create a comprehensive report detailing the database architecture
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Verify completeness of collection documentation against Firebase console
2. Cross-check ERD with actual database structure
3. Validate security rules documentation through Firebase security simulator
4. Peer review of the final report for accuracy and completeness

tasks.title: Analyze Bible Access Module Implementation
tasks.description: Conduct a thorough analysis of the Bible Access Module, documenting its architecture, performance characteristics, and API patterns.
tasks.details:
1. Review Bible Access Module source code
2. Document the module's architecture and main components
3. Analyze and document API patterns: getBibleSection, searchBibleContent, buildBibleContext
4. Investigate and document caching strategies and token optimization methods
5. Analyze cross-reference system and hierarchical navigation
6. Document performance characteristics and optimization techniques
7. Create a technical specification document for the Bible Access Module
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Verify API documentation against actual implementation
2. Conduct performance tests to validate documented characteristics
3. Review caching and optimization strategies through code analysis
4. Peer review of the technical specification document

tasks.title: Document CK Module System

2. Test dynamic loading patterns to ensure accurate documentation
3. Validate trigger keyword patterns through system logs
4. Peer review of the CK module system specification document

tasks.title: Analyze Workflow Patterns and Performance

tasks.title: Prepare Technical Specification Package for Manus AI
tasks.description: Compile all documentation and analysis into a comprehensive technical specification package for Manus AI roadmap generation.
tasks.details:
1. Gather all documentation created in previous tasks
2. Organize documentation into a logical structure for easy navigation
3. Create an executive summary highlighting key findings and system capabilities
4. Develop a gap analysis between current capabilities and autonomous development requirements
5. Identify and document proven patterns that should be preserved in B8-B9 evolution
6. Compile a list of technical constraints and performance baselines for design decisions
7. Create a final technical specification package with all relevant documentation
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Conduct a comprehensive review of the technical specification package
2. Verify that all components from previous tasks are included and properly referenced
3. Validate the gap analysis against the PRD requirements
4. Peer review of the final technical specification package by system architects and development team members
